imports.errorUnknownReference: A row refers to a record that does not exist.
imports.errorConflict: This overlaps a rate card that already covers the lane.
imports.errorUnknown: The import could not be completed.

support.bannerRead: Support has read access to your data
support.bannerWrite: Support has write access to your data
support.bannerMany: {count} support sessions have access to your data
support.pageDescription: Support access is granted by you, scoped to branches, expires on its own and is recorded. Nothing below can be edited afterwards — including by us.
support.emptyTitle: No support access has ever been granted
support.emptyHint: When support needs to look at your data, you grant it here — for a fixed period, to named branches, against a ticket.

supportGrant.title: Grant support access
supportGrant.description: Opens this deployment to one named engineer, for a fixed period. It expires on its own and you can withdraw it at any time.
supportGrant.engineerPlaceholder: Choose who is being granted access
supportGrant.reasonPlaceholder: SUP-1042 — invoice total disputed on KWI-2026-01041
supportGrant.reasonHint: Recorded against every session opened under this grant.
supportGrant.branchesHint: Leave blank for the branches you hold. Choosing fewer is always safer.
supportGrant.escalateHint: Only needed for read and write. Type GRANT WRITE to confirm.
supportGrant.note: Every session opened under this grant is recorded, and the record cannot be edited or deleted by anyone — including us.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.description: The link may be out of date, or the record may have been closed. If you reached this from inside the system, the reference may belong to a branch you do not have access to.

errorPage.title: We could not finish that
errorPage.description: The problem has been recorded. Nothing you were working on has been lost — a page that fails does not write anything.
errorPage.referenceHint: Quote this when you contact support. It matches the entry in our logs.

parties.title: Who prints on the documents
parties.description: Printed on the bill of lading exactly as entered, and kept as entered — a document records what was said, not what is currently true.
parties.name: Name
parties.taxIdHint: Prints on the bill in some jurisdictions
parties.noneHint: A bill of lading needs a shipper and a consignee before it can be issued.

cargo.title: What is in the shipment
cargo.dialogDescription: Printed verbatim on the bill of lading — the carrier prints what it is given, and nothing here improves the shipper’s wording.
cargo.marksHint: Laid out as stencilled on the cartons
cargo.hsCodeHint: For the customs pack and the duty estimate
cargo.containerHint: Groups the packing list by container
cargo.noneHint: Documents and the duty estimate both read from these.

documentActions.title: Issue and preview
documentActions.needsCargo: Add cargo lines first — every document below reads from them.
documentActions.surrenderHint: Telex release: the shipper has handed the originals back and the agent releases without them.
documentActions.surrenderedOn: Surrendered {date} — telex release. Copies print stamped; no originals.
documentActions.issueNote: Preview renders and stores nothing. Issue keeps the copy that was handed over and supersedes the previous version — regenerating never replaces.

hints.house_bill: Contract of carriage. Three originals and copies; watermarked until numbered.
hints.packing_list: Grouped by container, with net weight.
hints.customs_pack: What the broker would otherwise retype.
hints.air_waybill: Not negotiable. Names the consignee — no order bills in the air.

consolidations.title: Consolidations
consolidations.description: Many house bills under one master, and the cost split between them.
consolidations.dialogDescription: The master-level facts, shared by every house under it.
consolidations.coloaderHint: Set where we bought the space rather than sold it
consolidations.modeHint: A house cannot join a master of a different mode
consolidations.noneHint: Open one when you have a master bill with more than one house under it.
consolidations.noHousesHint: Attach the shipments sailing under this master.
consolidations.addChargeDescription: What the consolidation cost or earned as a whole. The basis decides how it divides across the houses.
consolidations.chargeDirectionHint: A cost is what we were charged; revenue is what we sold the space for
consolidations.fxRateHint: To the branch base currency, captured now
consolidations.basisHint: Every basis except manual reads figures the system already holds
consolidations.noChargesHint: Per-house margin is a fiction until the master cost is split.
consolidations.allocationNote: A split writes an ordinary charge line onto every house, so job profitability, invoicing and the accounting export need to know nothing about consolidation. Reversing posts the negative rather than deleting, because the lines may already sit on an issued invoice.
consolidations.shares: Split across {count, plural, one {# house} other {# houses}}

sections.carrierHint: The master bill belongs here, not on any house

accountingExport.previewDescription: Builds the journal and marks nothing. Run it as often as you like before posting.
accountingExport.previewNote: Nothing is consumed by a preview — every invoice, cost and receipt stays available to post.
accountingExport.postTitle: Post the period to the ledger
accountingExport.postDescription: Stamps every invoice, cost and receipt it covers. A second export of the same period will find nothing.
accountingExport.postWarning: This consumes the period. Getting back requires voiding the export, with a reason — so post once you are satisfied with the preview.
accountingExport.branchHint: Each entity posts to its own chart of accounts
accountingExport.voidDescription: Releases every invoice, cost and receipt this export claimed, so the period can be exported again.
accountingExport.voidReasonHint: Kept on the record. This is what answers “why was this period posted twice”.
accountingExport.voidWarning: Nothing is deleted. The export stays on the list, marked void with this reason, and the period becomes exportable again.

duty.title: Estimate duty and landed cost
duty.description: Matched by HS prefix against the tariff in force today. An estimate, not an assessment.
duty.freightHint: Duty is assessed on CIF — leaving this out understates it
duty.generalRate: Apply the GCC general rate to unclassified lines
duty.generalRateHint: Off by default. 5% on a code the tariff has no row for is a guess that looks researched.
duty.note: The assessed figure is whatever the authority determines on filing. The estimate and the assessment are both kept, so the gap between them can be measured.

charges.title: Charge ledger
charges.accruedHint: Not yet billed by a supplier
charges.belowFloor: Below the {floor}% margin floor — an invoice needs a Branch Manager's approval.
charges.none: No charges on this job yet
charges.noneHint: Costs appear here as they are accrued, allocated or entered. Revenue appears as it is priced.

chargeForm.formHint: The amount is quantity × rate, rounded to the currency.
chargeForm.directionHint: A buy is what the shipment costs us; a sell is what the customer is charged.
chargeForm.descriptionHint: Optional — what this charge was for
chargeForm.fxRateHint: Taken now and kept on the line, so this figure never moves again.
chargeForm.counterpartyHint: The agent, carrier or haulier this cost is owed to

sections.howMuchHint: Money is held to six decimal places and rounded to the currency, never to two.

payables.title: Payables
payables.description: What suppliers have billed, and where it disagrees with what the job accrued.
payables.needsReviewHint: Bills outside tolerance, or matched to nothing
payables.awaitingApprovalHint: Captured, not yet released for payment
payables.overdueHint: Past their due date and unpaid
payables.noneHint: Capture what an agent or a line has billed, and match it against the job's cost lines.
payables.noLines: No lines on this bill yet
payables.noLinesHint: Enter their lines as they wrote them, then match each one to the cost it should settle.
payables.paymentsHint: Money that has left the building and is not against a bill — a deposit, an advance, or a payment that arrived before its invoice.
payables.allAllocated: Every payment is against a bill.

payableForm.captureHint: Enter it as it arrived. Matching it against the job's costs comes next.
payableForm.readBillHint: Upload the scan and its lines are captured for you.
payableForm.readBillNote: It lands as received, like anything typed in — finance still approves it before it can be paid. If the figures do not add up, nothing is written and the scan is kept on file.
payableForm.scanHint: A PDF, or a photograph of the printout
payableForm.referenceHint: Exactly as printed — capturing the same number twice is refused.
payableForm.fxRateHint: Taken now and kept on the row, so the payable never revalues.
payableForm.chargeTypeHint: Optional — set it when you know which of ours this is.
payableForm.lineDescriptionHint: Their words, not ours — it is what ties the row back to the document.
payableForm.addLineTitle: Add a line from their invoice
payableForm.addLineHint: One row per line on their document.
payableForm.matchTitle: Match this line to a cost
payableForm.matchHint: Pick the cost line this should settle. Billing more than we accrued is allowed — that is the finding.
payableForm.varianceWarning: Some lines are outside tolerance, or matched to nothing at all.
payableForm.acceptVarianceHint: Only if you have decided the difference is acceptable.
payableForm.allocateHint: Part payments are the norm; allocate what this covers.
payableForm.recordPaymentTitle: Record a payment to a supplier
payableForm.recordPaymentHint: Allocate it against their bills afterwards.

actions.approveHint: Approving releases this bill for payment.
actions.disputeHint: Say what is wrong with it — this goes on the record.
actions.voidHint: Only where nothing has been paid against it.

sections.moneyHint: The total is the sum of the lines; add them next.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.description: What an agent owes us, netted against what we owe them, settled monthly.
settlements.noneHint: Draft one for a period and both sides of the account are netted into a single figure.
settlements.noPartners: No partner is linked to a customer record yet, so there is no account to net. Link one on their partner page.
settlements.noAccount: No current account with this partner
settlements.noAccountHint: Link them to the customer record they invoice us as, and both sides of the relationship net into one balance.
settlements.nothingOpenHint: Every document with this partner has been settled or netted.
settlements.noDocumentsHint: Nothing was open in that period, in that currency.

settlementForm.agentHint: Only partners linked to a customer record appear here.
settlementForm.agreedRateHint: One currency by agreement — a set-off is not a currency trade.
settlementForm.draftHint: Everything open in the period, in the agreed currency, that no earlier settlement has claimed.
settlementForm.linkTitle: Link this partner to a customer
settlementForm.linkHint: Needed before a set-off can be run.
settlementForm.linkNote: An agent is both a supplier and a customer. Nothing guesses at which customer record they are — a wrong guess nets a settlement against a different company.
settlementForm.toleranceHint: How far their bills may drift from what a job accrued.
settlementForm.toleranceNote: Whichever limit is the more generous applies. Leaving both at zero means the charge type's own tolerance is used instead.

credit.title: Standing and exceptions
credit.unconvertible: Not included above, for want of an exchange rate: {list}. The exposure shown is a floor, not a total.
credit.noOverrides: No exception has ever been made for this customer.

creditForm.title: Let this customer trade past their limit
creditForm.description: The limit stays where it is. This records the exception, who made it and why.
creditForm.standing: This customer owes {exposure} against a limit of {limit}.
creditForm.expiresOnHint: Leave blank and this covers nothing — a booking needs a date, because the shipment does not exist yet.
creditForm.expiresOnHintOneShot: Leave blank to cover only this one. A date covers everything for this customer until then.
creditForm.reasonHint: A sentence somebody reviewing this in a year can act on. Not 'approved'.

pod.title: Proof of delivery
pod.noneHint: Capture the signature at the door and this becomes the record a claim turns on.
pod.captureDescription: Who signed, when, and what they received. The signature and photographs are optional — the record is not.
pod.correctDescription: The original is kept and marked as corrected. Nothing is overwritten.
pod.deliveredAtHint: When the cargo changed hands, not when you are filling this in.
pod.receivedByNameHint: The person at the door, not the company on the waybill.
pod.signatureHint: Sign with a finger or a stylus.
pod.photosHint: The cargo at the door, any damage, the signed paper.
pod.hasException: Something was wrong — short, damaged or refused
pod.exceptionNotesHint: The delivery is still recorded. This is what a claim will be argued from.
pod.locationAsking: Asking the device for its location…
pod.locationCaptured: Location captured, accurate to about {accuracy} m.
pod.locationUnavailable: No location — the delivery records without one.

reports.title: Margin report
reports.subtitle: Shipments departing between {from} and {to}, by the date they sailed.
reports.emptyHint: No shipment with charge lines departed between these dates. Widen the range, or check that costs have been entered.

network.retireDescription: Takes it out of every picker in the product. Nothing already pointing at it changes.
network.retireWarning: Nothing is deleted. The row stays on this list, marked inactive, and can be brought back at any time.
network.restoreDescription: Puts it back in the pickers it was taken out of.
network.restoreNote: It becomes selectable again everywhere it was before.

jobActions.setStatusTitle: Where has this shipment got to?
jobActions.setStatusDescription: Sets the status by hand. Holding, cancelling and closing each need their own permission.
jobActions.reasonHint: Required when cancelling — it stays on the record.
jobActions.recordMilestoneDescription: What the customer sees on the tracking page, and what the portal reads.
jobActions.reachedAtHint: Leave empty for now. Milestones are typed up later far more often than live.
jobActions.undoHint: Clears the time on a milestone recorded by mistake.
jobActions.addContainerDescription: The unit a free-time clock runs against and a proof of delivery is signed for.
jobActions.containerNoHint: Four letters and seven digits, as it is stencilled on the box.

jobPartners.title: Who is moving it
jobPartners.hint: The companies we placed the work with — not the shipper and consignee on the bill.
jobPartners.referenceHint: Their booking or job number — what you quote when you ring them.
jobPartners.addTitle: Engage a partner on this shipment
jobPartners.addDescription: The carrier, the agent at the far end, the haulier. This is who gets settled with.

notificationTemplates.pageSubtitle: What the product says when it writes to a customer or a colleague. Change it here — no release needed.
notificationTemplates.title: Wording for {event}
notificationTemplates.description: Leave the branch empty to change it everywhere, or pick one to reword it for that entity alone.
notificationTemplates.branchHint: A row for an entity overrides the default beneath it.
notificationTemplates.subject: Subject
notificationTemplates.fieldsHint: Available fields: {fields}. Anything else sends as blank.
notificationTemplates.activeHint: Turn off to fall back to the default beneath it.
notificationTemplates.none: No wording set for this event.
notificationTemplates.noneHint: Nothing will be sent until there is a template — the send is recorded as failed.
notificationTemplates.footnote: Templates are rows, not code. Editing one takes effect on the next send.
notificationTemplates.sendingHint: Separate from the wording below. Turning an event off here stops it being sent; deactivating its template only falls back to the default beneath it.
notificationTemplates.masterHint: Off silences every event on this channel, whatever the switches beneath say. Nothing is lost — each notification is still recorded, marked held back.
notificationTemplates.masterOverrides: Held back while outbound email is off.

document.released: A document is released to the customer

quote.expiring: A quotation is about to expire

rate_card.expiring: A rate card is about to lapse

notificationTemplates.logHint: Every notification and what became of it. Failures first.
notificationTemplates.noDeliveriesHint: Notifications appear here the moment one is raised.

milestoneForm.title: A step in the plan
milestoneForm.description: What a job of this shape gets when it is booked.
milestoneForm.nameArHint: The customer sees this on tracking.
milestoneForm.ownerRoleHint: Which role is accountable. Drives escalation.
milestoneForm.offsetDaysHint: From the previous step, for the planned date.
milestoneForm.customerVisibleHint: Off keeps it to the ops board.
milestoneForm.appliesToNew: Applies to jobs booked from now on. Shipments already in flight keep the plan they were given.

calendarForm.title: Working calendar
calendarForm.description: The working week every SLA, ageing and free-time clock is counted against.
calendarForm.weekendHint: Weekday numbers, 0 is Sunday. Kuwait is 5,6.

holidayForm.title: A day the office is shut
holidayForm.description: Excluded from every SLA and free-time calculation.
holidayForm.note: Dated rather than recurring — Eid moves against the Gregorian calendar, so next year’s dates are entered next year.

dutyRateForm.title: Tariff line
dutyRateForm.description: What clearance is estimated at. Matched by the longest prefix the HS code starts with.
dutyRateForm.hsPrefixHint: Digits only. 8703 beats 87 — both are valid rows.
dutyRateForm.ratePercentHint: The GCC common external tariff is 5.
dutyRateForm.effectiveFromHint: A declaration is estimated against the line in force on its own date.
dutyRateForm.effectiveToHint: Leave empty while it still applies.

freeTime.title: Free time
freeTime.description: The days before demurrage starts, and what it costs after.
freeTime.kindHint: Demurrage is the box at the port; detention is the box off it; storage is the warehouse.
freeTime.containerHint: Leave empty where the clock is not per box.
freeTime.startsOnHint: Discharge, or gate out — whichever this kind counts from.
freeTime.endsOnHint: Set it when the box comes back. Stops the accrual; charged days stay.
freeTime.freeDaysHint: Nothing configured for this mode — type the terms.
freeTime.fromRules: From this branch’s free-time rules. Change it if this shipment differs.
freeTime.counterpartyHint: The carrier or the terminal the days are owed to.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Read-only keys a customer’s own systems use to pull their shipments and milestones.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.expiresHint: Leave empty for a key that does not expire.
apiKeys.noneHint: A customer integrating with the read API needs one.
apiKeys.onceOnly: Copy this now — it is shown once and is not stored. If it is lost, revoke the key and issue another.
apiKeys.footnote: Keys are revoked, never deleted: when one stopped working has to stay answerable.
apiKeys.webhooksHint: Where we post an event the moment it happens, so a customer’s system does not have to poll.
apiKeys.urlHint: Must be https. Each delivery is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in x-qabandi-signature.
apiKeys.eventsHint: Space separated. Leave empty to receive everything.
apiKeys.secretOnce: The signing secret. Give it to whoever receives these — they verify the signature with it.
apiKeys.noEndpointsHint: Customers poll the read API instead.

chargeableForm.title: Volumetric rule
chargeableForm.description: What a shipment on this mode is deemed to weigh.
chargeableForm.branchHint: A branch that negotiated its own divisor gets a row here.
chargeableForm.divisorHint: cm³ per kg — air 6000, courier 5000, sea LCL 1000. Empty for per-container.

freeTimeRuleForm.title: Free-time terms
freeTimeRuleForm.description: What this branch grants before the clock starts charging.
freeTimeRuleForm.narrowHint: Leave empty to apply everywhere. A narrower row wins over a wider one.
freeTimeRuleForm.dayBasisHint: Carriers usually count calendar days; terminals sometimes do not.

partnerContactForm.title: Contact at this partner
partnerContactForm.description: Who to ring, and what they answer for.
partnerContactForm.roleHint: Operations, accounts, the person who answers at 2am.
partnerContactForm.isPrimaryHint: Setting this moves it off whoever holds it now.

partnerCoverageForm.title: A lane this partner covers
partnerCoverageForm.description: Name a port where they quote one, a country where they cover the whole of it.
partnerCoverageForm.transitDaysHint: What they quote port to port.
partnerCoverageForm.countryHint: Two-letter code, where they cover the country rather than a port.

partnerComplianceForm.title: Licence or certificate
partnerComplianceForm.description: What they hold, and when it lapses.
partnerComplianceForm.expiresOnHint: The nightly check warns before this date.
partnerComplianceForm.supersedesHint: The one it replaces stays on file — it proves cover on the day a shipment moved.

mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.subtitle: The addresses this system reads. Mail arriving in one becomes an enquiry for that branch, or joins the thread of the job it quotes.
mailboxes.noneYetHint: Connect the address each office already publishes, and its mail starts arriving on the enquiry board within a minute.
mailboxes.connectSubtitle: Mail arriving here becomes an enquiry for the branch you choose.
mailboxes.editSubtitle: Leave the password blank to keep the one already stored.
mailboxes.branchHint: The office whose enquiries arrive here.
mailboxes.usernameHint: The mailbox to read — usually the address customers already write to.
mailboxes.hostHint: Ask whoever runs the mail. Microsoft 365 is outlook.office365.com.
mailboxes.passwordHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again after saving.
mailboxes.passwordKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the stored password. Type a new one to replace it.
mailboxes.archiveFolderHint: Optional. Leave blank to mark mail read where it is.
mailboxes.errorHint: A mailbox that is not reading collects no enquiries. Check the password first — most failures here are a credential that changed.
mailboxes.noKey: This deployment has no MAILBOX_ENCRYPTION_KEY set, so a password cannot be stored securely and this form cannot be saved. Set it and restart the service.
mailboxes.deactivateSubtitle: Mail arriving here will no longer become enquiries.
mailboxes.deactivateWarning: Mail already collected is kept. New mail will be left alone until this is turned back on.
mailboxes.reactivateSubtitle: Unread mail already in the folder will be collected on the next check.
mailboxes.reactivateWarning: Anything unread that has accumulated since this was stopped will arrive as enquiries.
mailboxes.noBranchRole: You hold no branch role, so there is no branch you can connect a mailbox for. Ask an administrator to give you a role in the office whose mail you need to read.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: The accounts this system reaches the outside world with — the relay that sends the mail, the carrier registrations that feed the board, the provider that will transmit the invoices. Changing one takes effect within a minute; none of it needs a release.
integrations.driverHint: What this deployment uses. The first option in each list is the one that costs nothing and asks nobody.
integrations.credentialsHint: Sealed on the way in and never shown again. Leave a field blank to keep the credential already stored.
integrations.secretKeepHint: A credential is stored. Leave this blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
integrations.secretHint: Nothing is stored yet. Falls back to {variable} until one is saved here.
integrations.fromEnv: Currently answered by {variable}. Type over it to save a value that takes precedence.
integrations.fromNothing: Not set anywhere. Falls back to {variable} if that is set later.
integrations.editSubtitle: Saved values take precedence over the deployment environment. Credentials are sealed and are never shown again.
integrations.noKey: A credential cannot be sealed on this deployment.
integrations.failingHint: An integration marked not working is one the service could not resolve on its last run. The reason is shown on the card; correcting it here takes effect within a minute.
integrations.missingHint: Still needed before this can be switched on: {fields}.
integrations.callsUnknown: Cannot be worked out from this schedule
integrations.deactivateSubtitle: The deployment falls back to its environment variables. Nothing typed here is lost.
integrations.reactivateSubtitle: These settings take precedence over the environment again.
integrations.deactivateWarning: The saved settings are kept but ignored, and the deployment goes back to whatever its environment variables say. This is how a change is rolled back.
integrations.reactivateWarning: The settings saved here take precedence over the environment again.

descriptions.smtp: The relay every notification leaves through. Without it nothing reaches a customer and nobody can be sent a password reset.
descriptions.fx: A daily rate for each currency marked tracked. Nothing prices from the feed — a charge line keeps the rate it was struck at.
descriptions.carrierPoll: How often the poll asks, and how many shipments each run covers. Calls per hour has to stay under the carrier’s cap.
descriptions.carrierTracking: Where container milestones come from. The carriers publish their own events — free, self-serve, one registration each.
descriptions.carrierMaersk: Covers MAEU, MAEI, MCPU, SEAU and SEJJ. Registration is self-serve at developer.maersk.com.
descriptions.carrierHapag: Covers HLCU and HLXU, and takes an id as well as a secret. Registration is self-serve at api.hlag.com.
descriptions.carrierCmacgm: Covers CMDU, ANNU, APLU and CHNL. Registration is self-serve at apis.cma-cgm.net.
descriptions.whatsapp: The business number customer notifications go out from, where a deployment has one. Email is the fallback.
descriptions.einvoice: The accredited provider that files an invoice with the tax authority. We are not the access point and cannot be.
descriptions.inboundEmail: The shared secret a mail provider signs its forwarding webhook with. Separate from the mailboxes this system reads itself.
descriptions.ai: Reads supplier invoices and scans into structured rows for a person to confirm. The key switches it on; leave the model blank for the default. Billed per document, and an unread bill is simply one that gets typed.
descriptions.fileStore: Where every stored document lives — the rendered invoices, the bills of lading, the scans that arrive by mail. Without it documents render but cannot be kept.

smtp.log: Written to the log, not sent

carrierPoll.activeWithinMinutes: Only poll if somebody signed in within

groupHints.platform: Where documents are kept, and how mail comes in and goes out. Without these the product cannot store a file or write to a customer.
groupHints.carriers: Where container milestones come from, and how much of each carrier’s rate limit the poll is allowed to spend.
groupHints.finance: Exchange rates, and transmission to the tax authority. Both are off until somebody has bought them.
groupHints.intelligence: Reading documents with a model. Billed per document, and capped by a ceiling set here.

integrations.offHint: Set to “{driver}”. Nothing is configured here, and nothing needs to be — open Configure to switch it on.
integrations.offHintPlain: Not switched on. Open Configure to set it up.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.explain: Ask about your shipments, enquiries and invoices. It reads only what you can see.
assistant.composerHint: Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.emptyTitle: What would you like to know?
assistant.emptyHint: It looks things up before answering, and tells you what it checked. It cannot change anything — where an action makes sense it offers you the record to confirm on.
assistant.proposalNote: Suggested. Nothing has been changed — open the record to confirm.
assistant.truncated: It ran out of lookups before finishing. Try asking something narrower.
assistant.emptyReply: No answer came back that time. Ask again — it usually works on a second try.
assistant.noThreads: Nothing here yet. Ask something and it will be kept.
assistant.notConfiguredHint: The assistant needs an OpenRouter key before it can answer. An administrator can add one.
assistant.unreachable: The assistant service is not responding
assistant.unreachableHint: Your key is set — something between here and the model is down. Try again in a moment.

tools.get_supplier_variance: the supplier's bill against the job
tools.propose_transition: an action for you to confirm

suggestions.clearance: What is sitting in customs clearance?
suggestions.freeTime: Whose free time runs out this week?
suggestions.exceptions: What should I look at today?

proposals.readOnly: Read from the email by the assistant. Deciding needs the assign permission.
proposals.noEvidence: No line quoted — check the mail before accepting.

unbilled.title: Earned, not yet billed
unbilled.description: {count} shipments carrying {total} of revenue that has never reached an invoice.

grouping.title: Could share a container
grouping.description: {count} groups of loose shipments on the same lane and sailing.

twoFactor.errorInvalid: That code is not correct. Check your authenticator app and try again.
twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.backupHint: If you cannot use your authenticator app, enter one of your backup codes.

enrol.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enrol.subtitle: Your role needs a second factor. Set it up now to continue.

enrol.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand

rateRequests.title: Rates from agents
rateRequests.emptyDescription: Ask the agents who cover this lane for a rate.
rateRequests.empty: No agent has been asked yet.
rateRequests.pickDescription: Each agent gets one email. Their reply returns here.
rateRequests.noAgents: No agent covers this lane. Add coverage on the agent file.

renewals.title: Renewals in flight
renewals.description: Rate requests the expiry sweep opened to renew a lapsing lane.
